It is about fifteen minutes on foot. With that bag, I would take a taxi.
Sorry, can you say that again? The second what?
The second left. Not the first one — the first one is very small.
So, straight to the end, and then the second left. Is that right?
Almost. Straight, second left, and then the station is on your right, opposite a big hotel.
Opposite a hotel. Perfect. Can you show me on the map, please?
Of course. We are here, and the station is here. See? Two corner s, that is all.
Thank you very much. You are very kind.

Hey, it's me. You are near the hotel, right? Okay, listen, it is very easy. Come out of the hotel and turn left. Walk straight, two streets. Do not turn before that, because the first street goes down to the river and you do not want that. After two streets you see a bank on your right. The restaurant is on the corner, opposite the bank. Blue door, you cannot miss it. If you get to the big church, you walked too much, so come back one street. It is a ten minute walk, no more. And do not take a taxi for this, it is really close. See you in twenty minutes.

Thank you for calling the city information line. Here is what is open today, Sunday. The museum is open from ten to six. It is in the old town, next to the big square, and the entrance is on the small street behind the building, not in front. The market is closed today, and it opens again tomorrow at seven in the morning. The pharmacy on Market Street is open all day and all night. And please note: there is work on the main street this week, so the buses do not stop in front of the station. They stop two streets away, near the park. Thank you, and have a good Sunday.
Excuse me, where is the station? Is it near here? Sorry, left or right? So, straight for two streets and then left. Thank you very much.
